title: Watch a box size
summary: ResizeObserver reports changes to an element's size.
introduction: ResizeObserver reports changes to an element's size. Your task: Resize the window and compare the reported widths.

Explain the example for watch a box size

blocks.text: ResizeObserver reports changes to an element's size. This can help a chart fit its own box rather than the whole screen.

Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

blocks.code: A flexible box
blocks.title: Watch a box size

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ResizeObserver` watches the size of selected elements, which may differ from the size of the whole viewport.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: The console logs the content width when the box is first observed and when that size changes.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Avoid changing the observed size in a way that creates an endless resize loop.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Resize the window and compare the reported widths.
